root_cause.text: The vdpa_sim driver was missing a bounds check on the group parameter, allowing an out-of-bounds write when a group index equal to ngroups was assigned an ASID, since the check used `>` instead of `>=` for the upper bound validation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that vdpa_sim's `vdpasim_set_group_asid()` function had the check `if (group > vdpasim->dev_attr.ngroups)` which incorrectly allows `group == ngroups` to pass validation. The fix consolidates bounds checking in `vhost_vdpa.c` with the corrected condition `if (idx >= vdpa->ngroups || s.num >= vdpa->nas)`, using `>=` instead of `>` to properly reject group indices at or beyond ngroups. This prevents out-of-bounds array access when writing to the group-indexed data structure.
